checks.name: counts
checks.details: 100 families, 300 bilingual scenarios, 600 input records, 600 answer records

checks.name: unique_ids
checks.details: All scenario and language-record IDs are unique within their files

checks.name: answer_and_input_alignment
checks.details: Every input has one matching answer and a matching primary-scenario translation

checks.name: input_field_allowlist
checks.details: Only case_id, language, context, existing_decision, new_decision; no answer, rationale, family, or topic fields

checks.name: nonempty_bilingual_texts
checks.details: All required text fields present; Arabic script and English alphabet sanity checks passed

checks.name: exact_evidence_quotes
checks.details: 1800 source passages checked in each of the two answer-bearing exports; these are full passages, not minimal spans

checks.name: no_duplicate_full_inputs
checks.details: No repeated full context/rule/proposal tuple within a language; deliberate shared-family overlap remains

checks.name: contrast_families
checks.details: Each of 100 dependent families has one scenario per label

checks.name: all_exports_match_authoring_source
checks.details: Every bilingual scenario was matched to its authoring family and variant

checks.name: readable_review_count
checks.details: 300 review entries with Arabic and English texts and reasons

checks.name: numeric_token_audit
checks.details: Four inspected notation differences only: Arabic first vs English 1 (April/July), Arabic 12 vs English twelve. No unresolved digit-token discrepancy. This is not a proof of translation equivalence.

semantic_review.reviewer_type: Authoring AI self-review, not independent review
semantic_review.scope: All 100 families and 300 proposed answers reviewed for conditional applicability, actual coverage, dates, boundaries, arithmetic, and intended Arabic/English equivalence.

corrections.change: Removed alternative from unspecified site X to avoid implying it cannot be the office.
Unknown-time notice scenario moved to two calendar days before the meeting so the 48-hour condition can be met or missed.
Annual training threshold made explicitly at least 20 hours.
Explicitly prohibited unapproved channels; retained distinction between preference and mandatory rule.
Clarified that both stock batches are available and valid at the relevant issue times.
Missing-information variant now omits start-day number rather than using an incoherent before/after-day-end distinction.
Retention rule explicitly ends at project closure; administrative priority remains outside the semantic task.

limitations: No independent model or human expert validated the labels.
Checks validate structure and internal alignment, not truth of all labels or translation quality.
AI-generated short synthetic cases; explicit unknown-fact wording can introduce shortcuts.
100 dependent contrast families; 600 language cases are not independent observations.
Balanced classes do not represent real-world prevalence.
This tests supplied-text semantic comparison, not permissions, retrieval, or administrative-effect correctness.
Case interpretations and bilingual labels should be independently checked by two qualified reviewers before research adoption.
